code.title: Setup code
code.introWizard: Welcome to modl. This wizard sets up your panel in a few steps.
code.introClaim: To start, enter the setup code printed in your server console (also saved in setup-code.txt) and the email you will sign in with. This account becomes the owner.

nav.saveFailed: Could not save your progress. Try again.

account.title: Sign-in method
account.intro: Choose how you and your staff sign in to the panel. You can change this later in the settings, where everyone can also add a passkey or two-factor authentication to their account.
account.emailCodeDescription: Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. Until email is set up, the code is printed in the server console.
account.passwordDescription: Sign in with your email and a password.

identity.title: Server identity
identity.intro: The server name and language shown on the panel and on the public pages for your players.
identity.nameTooLong: The server name can be at most {{max}} characters.
identity.conflict: The settings were changed somewhere else in the meantime. Check your values and press Continue again to save them.
identity.saveFailed: Could not save the server identity. Try again.

address.title: Panel address
address.intro: The address where players and staff open this panel. modl uses it in every link it sends, such as in-game panel links, ticket links, and emails.
address.unreachable: modl could not reach itself at this address. Check the address, the port, and your firewall.
address.otherService: Something else answered at this address. Check that it points to this modl server.
address.invalid: This is not a valid http or https address.
address.checkFailed: The check could not run. Try again.
address.localOnly: This address only works on the machine that runs modl. Use the public address or domain so that players and staff can open links.
address.insecure: This address does not use HTTPS, so sign-in codes and sessions travel unencrypted. If the panel is reachable from the internet, put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
address.reverseProxyPlugin: Requests arrive through a reverse proxy, but modl does not trust its headers. Set embedded.trust-proxy-headers to true in plugins/modl/connection.yml and restart the server so that modl sees the real client address.
address.reverseProxyStandalone: Requests arrive through a reverse proxy, but modl does not trust its headers. Set MODL_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS=true and restart modl so that it sees the real client address.

email.title: Email
email.intro: modl can send sign-in codes, ticket replies, and staff invitations by email through your own mail server (SMTP). Without email, sign-in codes are printed in the server console and invitations are shared as links.

servers.title: Minecraft servers
servers.intro: Add each Minecraft server or proxy that runs the modl plugin. Each one gets its own key, which you paste into the plugin's connection.yml.

minecraftAccount.title: Minecraft account
minecraftAccount.intro: Link your Minecraft account to open the panel from in game with /modl panel.

staff.title: Staff
staff.revokeDescription: The invitation link sent to {{email}} stops working.
staff.intro: Invite the people who help moderate your server. Each one gets a role that decides what they can see and do.

ai.title: AI moderation
ai.intro: AI moderation reviews chat reports with an AI provider of your choice and can punish rule breakers automatically. It needs an API key from that provider.

content.title: Finish
content.intro: Your panel is ready. modl added the default content below so you can start moderating right away. Change it, and everything else, in Settings.

finish.servers: Connect more servers and proxies, and manage their keys.
finish.roles: Decide what each staff role can see and do.
finish.punishmentTypes: Change durations, escalation, and which staff can issue each punishment.
finish.forms: Edit the forms players fill in for reports, appeals, and support.
finish.security: Add a passkey or two-factor authentication to your account.
finish.docs: Guides for every feature, command, and setting.
